up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3892 (Sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor 3). Required output columns: assay ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from assays table), target type (from target_type table), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (standard_type from activities), and pChEMBL value (pchembl_value from activities). Apply the following filters: target CHEMBBL ID must be CHEMBL3892, organism must be Homo sapiens (tax_id 9606), target type must be SINGLE PROTEIN, standard relation must be '=', pChEMBL value must not be null, and standard type must be IC50. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the result to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, tt.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type AS standard_type, a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBBL3892' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND tt.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
